raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 duplicate txn_ids are amount corrections. Per the 2026-01-17 payments-source note, a corrected record repeats the txn_id with record_version incremented, and silver_transactions keeps every version. The fix keeps only the latest record_version per txn_id, applying the POSTED filter after that selection so a superseded version cannot survive.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
